# Setup

```{r setup-data}
source("Functions/init.R")
source_functions()
source("Functions/models/cover_specs.R")
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_custom1())

vmc <- if (is.null(params$vmc)) opt$vmc else params$vmc

# the climates predicted by 03_predict_raster.R and the combine scripts:
# "minimal": current and the two 1 km futures (BNU-ESM, IPSL-CM5A-MR);
# "full": current, gridMET and the MACA GCMs (4 km)
climate_set <- params$climate_set %||% opt$climate_set %||% "minimal"
stopifnot(climate_set %in% c("minimal", "full"))

scenarios <- if (climate_set == "minimal") {
  c("current", "BNU-ESM", "IPSL-CM5A-MR")
} else {
  "current"  # gridMET and the GCMs are read in their own section
}
future <- setdiff(scenarios, "current")

# all final layers (% cover, or % of the total for shares), per scenario
pred <- map(scenarios, \(s) read_combined_all(vmc, s)) |>
  set_names(scenarios)

# what to map, in order; `group` is the tab. Shares come before covers
vars <- tribble(
  ~layer,             ~group,        ~label,
  "cover_tree",       "Tree",        "Tree cover",
  "share_needle",     "Needleleaf",  "Needleleaf share of tree cover",
  "cover_needle",     "Needleleaf",  "Needleleaf tree cover",
  "share_broad",      "Broadleaf",   "Broadleaf share of tree cover",
  "cover_broad",      "Broadleaf",   "Broadleaf tree cover",
  "cover_shrub",      "Shrub",       "Shrub cover",
  "cover_herbaceous", "Herbaceous",  "Herbaceous cover",
  "share_c3",         "C3 grass",    "C3 grass share of herbaceous cover",
  "cover_c3",         "C3 grass",    "C3 grass cover",
  "share_c4",         "C4 grass",    "C4 grass share of herbaceous cover",
  "cover_c4",         "C4 grass",    "C4 grass cover",
  "share_forb",       "Forb",        "Forb share of herbaceous cover",
  "cover_forb",       "Forb",        "Forb cover",
  "cover_bare_ground", "Bare ground", "Bare ground cover"
) |>
  mutate(is_share = str_detect(layer, "^share_"))
# bare ground only if this version of cover_specs$combined$all includes it
has_bare <- "cover_bare_ground" %in% names(pred$current)
if (!has_bare) vars <- filter(vars, layer != "cover_bare_ground")
stopifnot(all(vars$layer %in% names(pred$current)))

# legends underneath each map (overview)
legend_bottom <- theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                       legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                       legend.title.position = "top")

#' Colour scale for a cover or share layer
#'
#' Shares: 0-100%. Cover: 0 to the largest 99th percentile among `rasts`, so
#' the scenarios share one scale.
#'
#' @param rasts List of single-layer SpatRasters (e.g. one per scenario).
#' @param is_share Logical; a share (% of the total) rather than cover.
#' @return A ggplot2 fill scale.
value_scale <- function(rasts, is_share) {
  upper <- if (is_share) {
    100
  } else {
    max(map_dbl(rasts, \(r) raster_quantile(r, 0.99)))
  }
  colorscale_cover(name = if (is_share) "Share (%)" else "Cover (%)",
                   limits = c(0, upper))
}

#' Current and future maps of one layer, and the change from current
#'
#' Left column: current, then each future scenario (one colour scale).
#' Right column: future - current (one diverging scale, symmetric, set by the
#' largest 1st / 99th percentile of change); the legends sit beside current.
#' Inset histograms of all cells.
#'
#' @param layer Layer name in `pred`.
#' @param label Title.
#' @param is_share Logical; a share rather than cover.
#' @return A patchwork object.
plot_scenarios <- function(layer, label, is_share) {
  r <- map(pred, \(p) p[[layer]])
  change <- map(future, \(s) r[[s]] - r$current) |>
    set_names(future)
  change_lim <- map_dbl(change, \(d) {
    max(abs(c(raster_quantile(d, 0.01), raster_quantile(d, 0.99))))
  }) |>
    max()

  v_scale <- value_scale(r, is_share)
  c_scale <- colorscale_diverging(name = "Change (% points)",
                                  limits = c(-change_lim, change_lim))

  g_value <- imap(r, \(x, s) {
    plot_map_conus(x, colorscale = v_scale, title = s, inset_hist = TRUE)
  })
  g_change <- imap(change, \(x, s) {
    plot_map_conus(x, colorscale = c_scale, title = paste(s, "- current"),
                   inset_hist = TRUE)
  })

  # rows: current, then each future scenario; the legends go in the empty
  # cell beside current
  plots <- c(list(g_value$current, guide_area()),
             map(future, \(s) list(g_value[[s]], g_change[[s]])) |>
               list_flatten())
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(title = label) &
    theme(legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
          legend.title.position = "top")
}
```

# Components

Version `r vmc` of `cover_specs$combined$all`. All maps are predictions on
all of CONUS (snap mask), not only the available area. Shares are % of the
total (needleleaf and broadleaf: of tree cover, with broadleaf = 100% -
needleleaf as only needleleaf is modelled; C3, C4 and forb: of herbaceous
cover, rescaled to sum to 100%), and are predicted everywhere, including where
there is little or none of the total. Cover of a type is its share times the
total cover. Changes are in percentage points.

```{r components}
spec <- cover_specs$combined$all[[vmc]]
comp <- spec$components
tree_vmc <- comp$vmc[comp$component == "tree_all"]
herb_vmc <- comp$vmc[comp$component == "herbaceous"]

# the models behind tree_all and herbaceous
tree_all_comp <- cover_specs$combined$tree_all[[tree_vmc]]$components
herb_comp <- cover_specs$combined$herbaceous[[herb_vmc]]$components
# version of the combined tree cover (cover_specs$combined$tree) that
# tree_all is built from
combined_tree_vmc <- tree_all_comp$vmc[tree_all_comp$component == "tree"]

# the models behind each component
bind_rows(
  comp |> filter(component %in% c("shrub", "bare_ground")),
  tree_all_comp |> mutate(component = paste0("tree_all: ", component)),
  herb_comp |> mutate(component = paste0("herbaceous: ", component))
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# Current climate, all types

Each map has its own colour scale (covers: 0 to the 99th percentile; shares:
0-100%).

```{r map-all-current, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 14}
g_all <- pmap(vars, \(layer, label, is_share, ...) {
  r <- pred$current[[layer]]
  plot_map_conus(r, colorscale = value_scale(list(r), is_share),
                 title = label)
})
names(g_all) <- vars$layer

# rows: tree, needleleaf; broadleaf, shrub; herbaceous, bare ground (if
# modelled); herbaceous covers; shares
layout <- list(g_all$cover_tree, g_all$cover_needle, g_all$share_needle,
               g_all$cover_broad, g_all$share_broad, g_all$cover_shrub,
               g_all$cover_herbaceous,
               if (has_bare) g_all$cover_bare_ground else plot_spacer(),
               plot_spacer(),
               g_all$cover_c3, g_all$cover_c4, g_all$cover_forb,
               g_all$share_c3, g_all$share_c4, g_all$share_forb)
wrap_plots(layout, ncol = 3) & legend_bottom
```

```{asis, echo = climate_set == "full"}
# gridMET, Daymet and GCMs, by type {.tabset}

For each layer, on the gridMET grid (4 km), two figures with the same
layout:

1. **Change from gridMET**
   - Top row: the prediction under gridMET 1991-2020 normals, and the Daymet
     (1 km, 1991-2020 normals) prediction averaged onto the gridMET grid
  minus the gridMET prediction.
   - Two rows per RCP (2070-2099, the 20 MACAv2-METDATA GCMs), the change
  from gridMET (GCM - gridMET): per cell, the minimum, median and maximum
     across GCMs (so the GCM can differ from cell to cell); and the change
     under the GCMs with the lowest, median and highest CONUS-mean change
     (area-weighted, `gcm_deltas()`, as in 03_predict_raster.R; median =
     rank 10 of 20), ranked separately for each layer and RCP. The
     difference maps share one colour scale, symmetric, to the 99th
     percentile of the absolute differences.
2. **Predictions**: the same maps as predictions (% cover, or % share)
   rather than changes: gridMET, Daymet (averaged onto the gridMET grid),
   and for each RCP the per-cell minimum, median and maximum across GCMs
   and the predictions of the same lowest, median and highest GCMs. Each
   GCM's change subtracts the same gridMET value at a cell, so these maps
   are the change maps plus gridMET. All maps share one colour scale
   (covers: 0 to the largest 99th percentile; shares: 0-100%).

Inset histograms are of all cells. The GCM shares are computed from the
GCM predictions as for the other scenarios: needleleaf from its share model,
broadleaf = 100% - needleleaf, and C3, C4 and forb as their cover
(04_combine_herb.R) divided by herbaceous cover (the rescaled shares).
```

```{r gcm-data, eval = climate_set == "full"}
# MACA futures, as in 03_predict_raster.R
rcps <- c("rcp45", "rcp85")
period <- "2070-2099"
n_gcms <- 20
rcp_labels <- c(rcp45 = "RCP 4.5", rcp85 = "RCP 8.5")

# gridMET (4 km) predictions: the baseline for every difference
gridmet <- read_combined_all(vmc, "gridmet")
stopifnot(identical(names(gridmet), names(pred$current)))

# Daymet (1 km) predictions averaged onto the gridMET grid, as the soils are
# (read_soil_gridmet())
daymet_4km <- terra::project(pred$current, gridmet, method = "average")

#' All final layers for one RCP and period, one layer per GCM
#'
#' The GCM counterpart of read_combined_all(), on the gridMET grid: combined
#' tree cover (04_combine_tree.R), C3, C4 and forb cover (04_combine_herb.R),
#' and the needleleaf share, shrub, herbaceous and bare ground predictions
#' (03_predict_raster.R). The other layers are computed from these, as
#' read_combined_all() does for one scenario.
#'
#' @param rcp RCP, e.g. "rcp45".
#' @param period Period, e.g. "2070-2099".
#' @return Named list, one element per layer of vars$layer: SpatRaster with
#'   one layer per GCM, named by GCM.
#' @examples
#' rcp <- "rcp45"
#' period <- "2070-2099"
#' read_all_gcms(rcp = rcp, period = period)
read_all_gcms <- function(rcp, period) {
  scenario <- paste0(rcp, "_", period)

  tree <- terra::rast(combined_path("tree", combined_tree_vmc, "prediction",
                                    scenario))
  gcms <- names(tree)
  stopifnot(length(gcms) == n_gcms)

  # predictions of a single (not combined) model, with the GCMs in the same
  # order as tree cover's
  read_model <- function(m) {
    r <- terra::rast(cover_pred_path(m$cover_type, m$cover_model, m$vc,
                                     m$vmc, scenario))
    stopifnot(identical(names(r), gcms))
    r
  }
  needle <- read_model(tree_all_comp[tree_all_comp$component == "needle", ])
  shrub <- read_model(comp[comp$component == "shrub", ])
  herb <- read_model(herb_comp[herb_comp$component == "herbaceous", ])

  # C3, C4 and forb cover: layers cover_<type>_<gcm>
  herb_types <- terra::rast(combined_path("herbaceous", herb_vmc,
                                          "prediction", scenario))
  cover_c3 <- herb_types[[paste0("cover_c3_", gcms)]]
  cover_c4 <- herb_types[[paste0("cover_c4_", gcms)]]
  cover_forb <- herb_types[[paste0("cover_forb_", gcms)]]

  out <- list(
    cover_tree = tree,
    # as tree_leaf_cover(): broadleaf share is 100 - needleleaf share
    share_needle = needle,
    cover_needle = tree * needle / 100,
    share_broad = 100 - needle,
    cover_broad = tree * (100 - needle) / 100,
    cover_shrub = shrub,
    cover_herbaceous = herb,
    # each type's cover is its rescaled share times herbaceous cover
    # (split_cover()), so the share is cover / herbaceous cover
    share_c3 = 100 * cover_c3 / herb,
    cover_c3 = cover_c3,
    share_c4 = 100 * cover_c4 / herb,
    cover_c4 = cover_c4,
    share_forb = 100 * cover_forb / herb,
    cover_forb = cover_forb
  )
  if (has_bare) {
    out$cover_bare_ground <- read_model(comp[comp$component == "bare_ground", ])
  }
  stopifnot(all(vars$layer %in% names(out)))

  # every raster's layers are in the order of gcms (checked above, and kept by
  # the arithmetic), so they are named by GCM
  map(out[vars$layer], \(r) {
    names(r) <- gcms
    r
  })
}

#' Change from gridMET of one layer under one RCP
#'
#' @param preds SpatRaster, one layer per GCM, named by GCM: the layer's
#'   predictions under one RCP (read_all_gcms()).
#' @param base SpatRaster, one layer: the layer's gridMET prediction.
#' @return List: `summary`, SpatRaster with layers min, median and max: per
#'   cell, across GCMs, of GCM - gridMET; `by_role`, SpatRaster with layers
#'   lowest, median and highest: GCM - gridMET for the GCMs with the lowest,
#'   median and highest CONUS-mean change; `summary_pred` and `by_role_pred`,
#'   the same of the predictions themselves (not minus gridMET); `role_gcm`,
#'   the names of those GCMs (named lowest, median, highest); `deltas`, the
#'   gcm_deltas() table.
#' @examples
#' preds <- read_all_gcms("rcp45", "2070-2099")$cover_c3
#' base <- gridmet$cover_c3
#' gcm_change(preds = preds, base = base)
gcm_change <- function(preds, base) {
  # one layer per GCM
  change <- preds - base

  summary_r <- c(min(change), terra::median(change), max(change))
  names(summary_r) <- c("min", "median", "max")
  summary_pred <- c(min(preds), terra::median(preds), max(preds))
  names(summary_pred) <- c("min", "median", "max")

  # CONUS-mean change of each GCM, area-weighted (Functions/spatial.R)
  deltas <- gcm_deltas(preds, base)
  role_gcm <- c(lowest = deltas$gcm[which(deltas$role == "lowest")],
                median = deltas$gcm[which(deltas$role == "median")],
                highest = deltas$gcm[which(deltas$role == "highest")])
  stopifnot(length(role_gcm) == 3)
  by_role <- change[[role_gcm]]
  names(by_role) <- names(role_gcm)
  by_role_pred <- preds[[role_gcm]]
  names(by_role_pred) <- names(role_gcm)

  list(summary = summary_r, by_role = by_role,
       summary_pred = summary_pred, by_role_pred = by_role_pred,
       role_gcm = role_gcm, deltas = deltas)
}

# changes from gridMET (and the predictions), by RCP and layer. The GCM
# predictions are read one RCP at a time, as there are many of them
changes <- map(set_names(rcps), \(rcp) {
  preds <- read_all_gcms(rcp, period)
  map(set_names(vars$layer), \(layer) {
    gcm_change(preds[[layer]], gridmet[[layer]])
  })
})
```

```{r gcm-table, eval = climate_set == "full"}
imap(changes, \(by_layer, rcp_name) {
  bind_rows(map(by_layer, "deltas"), .id = "layer") |>
    mutate(rcp = rcp_labels[[rcp_name]])
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  filter(!is.na(role)) |>
  mutate(gcm = paste0(gcm, " (", round(delta, 2), ")")) |>
  left_join(select(vars, layer, label), by = "layer") |>
  arrange(factor(layer, levels = vars$layer), rcp) |>
  select(label, rcp, role, gcm) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = role, values_from = gcm) |>
  select(label, rcp, lowest, median, highest) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = paste(
    "GCMs with the lowest, median and highest CONUS-mean change from",
    "gridMET, for each layer and RCP (the change, in % points, in brackets)"))
```

```{r gcm-fun, eval = climate_set == "full"}
#' Maps of one layer: gridMET, Daymet, and the GCMs
#'
#' Row 1: gridMET, Daymet, and the legends. Then two rows per RCP: the
#' per-cell min, median and max across GCMs, and the lowest, median and
#' highest GCM (gcm_change()). With what = "change", every map but gridMET
#' is the difference from gridMET, on one diverging scale, symmetric, to the
#' 99th percentile of the absolute differences. With what = "prediction",
#' every map is a prediction (% cover or % share), on one scale
#' (value_scale()). Inset histograms of all cells.
#'
#' @param layer Layer name in `gridmet`.
#' @param label Title.
#' @param is_share Logical; a share rather than cover.
#' @param what "change" (from gridMET) or "prediction".
#' @return A patchwork object.
#' @examples
#' layer <- "cover_c3"
#' label <- "C3 grass cover"
#' is_share <- FALSE
#' what <- "change"
#' plot_gcm_layer(layer = layer, label = label, is_share = is_share,
#'                what = what)
plot_gcm_layer <- function(layer, label, is_share,
                           what = c("change", "prediction")) {
  what <- match.arg(what)
  base <- gridmet[[layer]]

  # the maps after gridMET: Daymet, and for each RCP the summaries across
  # GCMs and the GCMs by role, as changes from gridMET or as predictions
  daymet <- daymet_4km[[layer]]
  if (what == "change") daymet <- daymet - base
  rcp_maps <- map(changes, \(by_layer) {
    ch <- by_layer[[layer]]
    if (what == "change") {
      list(summary = ch$summary, by_role = ch$by_role)
    } else {
      list(summary = ch$summary_pred, by_role = ch$by_role_pred)
    }
  })

  # colour scales: gridMET's, and the one shared by the other maps
  others <- terra::rast(c(list(daymet),
                          map(rcp_maps, \(x) c(x$summary, x$by_role))))
  if (what == "change") {
    v <- as.vector(terra::values(others))
    lim <- quantile(abs(v), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
    others_scale <- colorscale_diverging(
      name = "Difference from\ngridMET (% points)", limits = c(-lim, lim))
    base_scale <- value_scale(list(base), is_share)
  } else {
    # one scale for every map, gridMET included
    others_scale <- value_scale(c(list(base), as.list(others)), is_share)
    base_scale <- others_scale
  }

  map_other <- function(r, title) {
    plot_map_conus(r, colorscale = others_scale, title = title,
                   inset_hist = TRUE)
  }

  # row 1; the legends go in the empty third panel
  top <- list(
    plot_map_conus(base, colorscale = base_scale,
                   title = "gridMET, 1991-2020", inset_hist = TRUE),
    map_other(daymet, if (what == "change") {
      "Daymet - gridMET"
    } else {
      "Daymet, 1991-2020"
    }),
    guide_area()
  )

  # two rows per RCP
  by_rcp <- imap(rcp_maps, \(x, rcp) {
    lab <- rcp_labels[[rcp]]
    gcm <- changes[[rcp]][[layer]]$role_gcm
    list(
      map_other(x$summary[["min"]], paste0(lab, ": min across GCMs")),
      map_other(x$summary[["median"]], paste0(lab, ": median across GCMs")),
      map_other(x$summary[["max"]], paste0(lab, ": max across GCMs")),
      map_other(x$by_role[["lowest"]],
                paste0(lab, ": lowest GCM (", gcm[["lowest"]], ")")),
      map_other(x$by_role[["median"]],
                paste0(lab, ": median GCM (", gcm[["median"]], ")")),
      map_other(x$by_role[["highest"]],
                paste0(lab, ": highest GCM (", gcm[["highest"]], ")"))
    )
  }) |>
    list_flatten()

  title <- if (what == "change") {
    paste0(label, ": change from gridMET")
  } else {
    paste0(label, ": predictions")
  }

  wrap_plots(c(top, by_rcp), ncol = 3) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(title = title) &
    theme(legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
          legend.title.position = "top")
}
```

```{r maps-gcm, eval = climate_set == "full", results = "asis", fig.width = 12, fig.height = 16}
walk(unique(vars$group), \(g) {
  cat("\n\n## ", g, "\n\n", sep = "")
  filter(vars, group == g) |>
    pwalk(\(layer, label, is_share, ...) {
      print(plot_gcm_layer(layer, label, is_share, what = "change"))
      cat("\n\n")
      print(plot_gcm_layer(layer, label, is_share, what = "prediction"))
      cat("\n\n")
    })
})
```

# Residuals

## Data

The observations are the training pixel-years of the data version of the
model(s) each layer comes from (`vc` in the fit metrics table). They are
compared with two kinds of predictions:

- **Fit metrics**: the predictions at those pixel-years, made with each
  pixel-year's own climate, in sample and out of fold (see Fit metrics).
- **Maps and quantile plots** (By type): the current-climate raster
  (normals, anomalies 0) extracted at the training pixels, in sample: the
  models were fit to these data, so this shows the spatial pattern of the
  errors, not an independent test (and for random forests the training
  points are in-bag). The maps show the mean over years at each pixel.

Observed values:

- **Tree cover**: `cov_tree`, set to 0 where the zero-tree layer
  (`zero_tree`) is 1, as for `c_needle` and `c_broad` (below). Its map
  instead compares wall to wall with 2021 RAP tree
  cover (cells passing the LCMAP and 2021 fire masks), with zero-tree cells
  (RAP zero-tree layer, at the zero-tree model’s threshold) set to 0, as in
  01_tree_combined_diagnostics.Rmd.
- **Everything else**: observed shares are the field fractions
  (`frac_<type>`, as %); observed cover of a type is its parent cover
  times its fraction, as the predictions are built, e.g. modelled
  `share_c3` is compared with `100 * frac_c3`, and `cover_c3` with
  `cov_herbaceous * frac_c3`. The
  exception is needleleaf and broadleaf cover, which are compared with
  `c_needle` and `c_broad`: the field fractions times RAP tree cover at
  the cell/year (0 where the RAP zero-tree layer is 1 or RAP tree cover is 0,
  even if the fraction is NA; see
  `08_combine_cover_and_covariates.R`), as the tree cover model is fit to
  RAP. These are NA where RAP has no tree cover for that cell-year, and
  where RAP has trees but the field fraction is NA. Broadleaf isn't
  modelled directly (its share is 100% minus the needleleaf share), so its
  observations are those of the needleleaf model, with `frac_broad`
  (= 1 - `frac_needle`). The
  other component covers (`c_<type>`) are not used: LFRDB's are summed
  species cover, which can exceed 100%, and LDC's are any-hit rather than
  first-hit.

Quantile plots use the training pixel-years and the f5 predictors
(`.pred_vars$f5`), whatever the models were fit with.

```{r resid-data}
# data version of the observations for each layer: that of the model(s) the
# layer comes from
tree_parts <- cover_specs$combined$tree[[combined_tree_vmc]]$components

vc_of <- function(x, comp) unname(comp$vc[comp$component == x])
vc_tree <- unique(tree_parts$vc[tree_parts$cover_type == "cover"])
stopifnot(length(vc_tree) == 1)

# by type (the layer name without cover_ / share_)
vc_lookup <- c(tree       = vc_tree,
               needle     = vc_of("needle", tree_all_comp),
               # broad isn't modelled directly (share = 1 - needle share)
               broad      = vc_of("needle", tree_all_comp),
               shrub      = vc_of("shrub", comp),
               # character(0), so dropped, when there's no bare_ground model
               bare_ground = vc_of("bare_ground", comp),
               herbaceous = vc_of("herbaceous", herb_comp),
               c3         = vc_of("c3", herb_comp),
               c4         = vc_of("c4", herb_comp),
               forb       = vc_of("forb", herb_comp))
vars <- vars |>
  mutate(type = str_remove(layer, "^(cover|share)_"),
         vc = unname(vc_lookup[type]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(vars$vc))

# zero-tree threshold of the combined tree cover's zero-tree model
zt <- filter(tree_parts, component == "zero_tree")

#' Observed value of a layer in the training data (%)
#'
#' Tree cover is set to 0 where the zero-tree layer (`zero_tree`) is 1 (where
#' that column exists), as the predictions are. Shares are the fractions
#' (`frac_<type>`) as %. Needleleaf and broadleaf cover are `c_needle` and
#' `c_broad` (field fraction x same-year RAP tree cover, from
#' `08_combine_cover_and_covariates.R`). Cover of c3, c4 and forb is
#' `cov_herbaceous` times the fraction, and 0 where `cov_herbaceous` is 0.
#'
#' @param d Training data (`read_cover_training()`).
#' @param layer Layer name, e.g. "cover_forb".
#' @return Numeric vector, NA where not observed.
observed_layer <- function(d, layer) {
  type <- str_remove(layer, "^(cover|share)_")
  if (layer == "cover_tree") {
    # the binary zero-tree layer, as for c_needle in
    # 08_combine_cover_and_covariates.R
    zero <- if ("zero_tree" %in% names(d)) {
      !is.na(d$zero_tree) & d$zero_tree == 1
    } else {
      rep(FALSE, nrow(d))
    }
    return(if_else(zero, 0, d$cov_tree))
  }
  if (type %in% c("shrub", "herbaceous", "bare_ground")) {
    return(d[[paste0("cov_", type)]])
  }
  frac <- d[[paste0("frac_", type)]]
  if (str_starts(layer, "share_")) return(100 * frac)
  # RAP-based, as the tree cover model is fit to RAP
  if (type %in% c("needle", "broad")) return(d[[paste0("c_", type)]])
  parent <- d$cov_herbaceous
  # fractions are undefined where the parent class is absent
  if_else(!is.na(parent) & parent == 0, 0, parent * frac)
}

# training data with the current predictions at each pixel (pred_<layer>),
# and whether the pixel is in the sagebrush region (load_sagebrush_mask())
train <- map(unique(vars$vc), \(v) {
  d <- read_cover_training(v)
  d$sagebrush <- in_sagebrush(d)
  p <- terra::extract(pred$current, as.matrix(d[c("x", "y")]))
  bind_cols(d, rename_with(as_tibble(p), \(n) paste0("pred_", n)))
}) |>
  set_names(unique(vars$vc))

f5 <- .pred_vars$f5

# wall-to-wall observed tree cover: 2021 RAP (default target year), LCMAP- and
# fire-masked
wall <- TRUE
if (wall) {
  rap_tree <- read_rap_cover_raster("tree", years = 2021)
  rap_zero <- read_zero_tree_raster("zeroTree")
  # GEE exports are one cell larger than the snap grid
  rap_tree <- align_raster(rap_tree, pred$current)
  rap_zero <- align_raster(rap_zero, pred$current)
  obs_tree <- terra::ifel(rap_zero == 1, 0, rap_tree) |>
    terra::mask(rap_tree) |>  # NA where either layer is missing
    terra::mask(rap_zero)
  diff_tree <- terra::mask(pred$current$cover_tree, obs_tree) - obs_tree
}
```

```{r resid-fun}
#' Pixel-year table of observed and predicted values of one layer
resid_df <- function(layer, vc) {
  train[[vc]] |>
    mutate(cover = observed_layer(train[[vc]], layer),
           cover_pred = .data[[paste0("pred_", layer)]]) |>
    filter(!is.na(cover), !is.na(cover_pred))
}

#' Map of predicted - observed at the training pixels (mean over years)
plot_resid_points <- function(df, label, unit) {
  px <- df |>
    summarise(resid = mean(cover_pred - cover), .by = c(cell, x, y)) |>
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = terra::crs(pred$current))
  lim <- max(abs(quantile(px$resid, c(0.05, 0.95), names = FALSE)))
  plot_points_conus(px, color_var = "resid", point_size = 0.3,
                    colorscale = colorscale_diverging(
                      name = paste0("Predicted -\nobserved\n(", unit, ")"),
                      limits = c(-lim, lim), aesthetics = "colour"),
                    title = paste(label, "- residuals at training pixels"),
                    inset_hist = TRUE)
}

#' Quantile plot of observed and predicted against the f5 predictors
plot_resid_quantiles <- function(df, label, ylab) {
  predvars2deciles(df, response_vars = c("cover", "cover_pred"),
                   pred_vars = f5) |>
    decile_dotplot("cover", df = _, ylab = ylab, add_predicted = TRUE,
                   title = label, add_ribbon = TRUE)
}
```

## Fit metrics

Predicted vs observed at the training pixel-years of each layer's data
version (`vc`). The predictions are those written by the combining scripts
for the combined layers (04_combine_tree.R, 05_combine_tree_all.R,
04_combine_herb.R), and those saved with the fitted model for shrub,
herbaceous and bare ground cover (`read_cover_predictions()`). Each uses the
pixel-year's own climate: the normals of the 30 years before it (20-29
years for field pixel-years before 2010, as Daymet starts in 1980), and its
anomalies for models that use them. `pred_in` is in sample (out-of-bag for
random forest components); `pred_oof` is out of fold (each component model
has its own environmental folds).

Pixel-years where `pred_oof` uses a prediction that isn't out of fold
(`fallback`; see the combining scripts) are left out of both, so `pred_in`
and `pred_oof` are on the same pixel-years; `pct_fallback` is the % left
out. These are pixel-years a component model wasn't fit to, e.g. tree_forest
(fit only where tree cover is > 10%) at pixel-years with tree cover <= 10%
where it gets weight in the blend, or the share models where the total cover
is 0 (the fractions are NA there). Total tree cover and herbaceous cover don't
count toward fallback for the needleleaf, broadleaf, C3, C4 and forb layers:
they are fit to other data, so at these pixel-years their predictions are
mostly or entirely full-model ones. For the C3, C4 and forb layers only their
own share model counts, as the other two shares only rescale it (e.g. forb
is kept at FIA-only pixel-years, which have no C3/C4 split).

Region: all pixel-years, those in the sagebrush region (sagebrush biome
mask, `load_sagebrush_mask()`), and those outside it. `n` is the number of
pixel-years. Units are % cover, or % share for shares. MSE is RMSE^2; R^2 is
1 - SSE/SST (negative when the predictions do worse than the observed mean);
bias is mean(predicted - observed). Needleleaf and broadleaf cover also get
rows for observed cover > 0 only, as observed zeros (e.g. where RAP tree
cover is 0) can inflate the fit.

```{r resid-metrics}
#' Predictions of a single (not combined) model at its pixel-years
#'
#' The predictions saved with the fitted model, at the rows it was fit to
#' (read_cover_predictions()).
#'
#' @param m One row of a combined spec's `components` tibble.
#' @param layer_name Name of the layer the model predicts, e.g. "cover_shrub".
#' @return Tibble: cell, year, pred_in, pred_oof, layer, and fallback (FALSE:
#'   every row is one the model was fit to, so pred_oof is out of fold).
#' @examples
#' m <- comp[comp$component == "shrub", ]
#' layer_name <- "cover_shrub"
#' single_model_preds(m = m, layer_name = layer_name)
single_model_preds <- function(m, layer_name) {
  stopifnot(nrow(m) == 1)
  read_cover_predictions(m$cover_type, m$cover_model, m$vc, m$vmc) |>
    mutate(layer = layer_name, fallback = FALSE)
}

# predictions at the pixel-years, one row per layer and pixel-year
pixel_preds <- bind_rows(
  # 04_combine_tree.R
  read_cover_predictions("combined", "tree", vc_tree, combined_tree_vmc) |>
    mutate(layer = "cover_tree"),
  # 05_combine_tree_all.R: share_ and cover_ needle and broad
  read_cover_predictions("combined", "tree_all", vc_lookup[["needle"]],
                         tree_vmc),
  single_model_preds(comp[comp$component == "shrub", ], "cover_shrub"),
  single_model_preds(herb_comp[herb_comp$component == "herbaceous", ],
                     "cover_herbaceous"),
  # 04_combine_herb.R: share_ and cover_ c3, c4 and forb, and share_sum
  read_cover_predictions("combined", "herbaceous", vc_lookup[["c3"]],
                         herb_vmc)
)
if (has_bare) {
  bare_preds <- single_model_preds(comp[comp$component == "bare_ground", ],
                                   "cover_bare_ground")
  pixel_preds <- bind_rows(pixel_preds, bare_preds)
}
pixel_preds <- select(pixel_preds, layer, cell, year, pred_in, pred_oof,
                      fallback)
stopifnot(all(vars$layer %in% pixel_preds$layer),
          !anyDuplicated(pixel_preds[c("layer", "cell", "year")]))

#' Observed and predicted values of one layer at its pixel-years
#'
#' The layer's rows of pixel_preds, joined by cell and year to its
#' observations (observed_layer()) in the training data of data version vc.
#'
#' @param layer_name Layer, e.g. "cover_c3".
#' @param vc Data version the layer's predictions were made at (vars$vc).
#' @return Tibble, one row per pixel-year with an observation: layer, cell,
#'   year, pred_in, pred_oof, fallback, sagebrush (TRUE in the sagebrush
#'   region), observed.
#' @examples
#' layer_name <- "cover_c3"
#' vc <- vars$vc[vars$layer == layer_name]
#' obs_pred_pixels(layer_name = layer_name, vc = vc)
obs_pred_pixels <- function(layer_name, vc) {
  d <- train[[vc]]
  obs <- tibble(cell = d$cell, year = d$year, sagebrush = d$sagebrush,
                observed = observed_layer(d, layer_name))
  p <- filter(pixel_preds, layer == layer_name)
  out <- inner_join(p, obs, by = c("cell", "year"))
  # each prediction matches exactly one pixel-year of the training data
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(obs[c("cell", "year")]),
            nrow(out) == nrow(p),
            !anyNA(out$pred_in), !anyNA(out$pred_oof))
  filter(out, !is.na(observed))
}

#' Fit metrics of one layer, by region and prediction type
#'
#' Pixel-years with fallback = TRUE are left out (see above).
#'
#' @param layer_name,vc As in obs_pred_pixels().
#' @param positive_only Logical; only pixel-years with observed > 0.
#' @return Tibble, one row per region and prediction type: region,
#'   predictions ("pred_in" or "pred_oof"), the cover_metrics() columns, and
#'   pct_fallback (% of the region's pixel-years left out).
#' @examples
#' layer_name <- "cover_needle"
#' vc <- vars$vc[vars$layer == layer_name]
#' positive_only <- FALSE
#' layer_metrics(layer_name = layer_name, vc = vc,
#'               positive_only = positive_only)
layer_metrics <- function(layer_name, vc, positive_only = FALSE) {
  d <- obs_pred_pixels(layer_name, vc)
  if (positive_only) d <- filter(d, observed > 0)

  # the pixel-years of each region, stacked
  d <- bind_rows(mutate(d, region = "all"),
                 mutate(filter(d, sagebrush), region = "sagebrush"),
                 mutate(filter(d, !sagebrush), region = "outside sagebrush"))

  fallback_pct <- summarise(d, pct_fallback = 100 * mean(fallback),
                            .by = region)

  d |>
    filter(!fallback) |>
    pivot_longer(c(pred_in, pred_oof), names_to = "predictions",
                 values_to = "predicted") |>
    reframe(cover_metrics(observed, predicted), .by = c(region, predictions)) |>
    left_join(fallback_pct, by = "region")
}

metrics <- pmap(vars, \(layer, label, vc, ...) {
  out <- mutate(layer_metrics(layer, vc), label = label)
  if (layer %in% c("cover_needle", "cover_broad")) {
    positive <- layer_metrics(layer, vc, positive_only = TRUE) |>
      mutate(label = paste0(label, ", observed > 0"))
    out <- bind_rows(out, positive)
  }
  mutate(out, vc = vc)
}) |>
  bind_rows()

metrics |>
  mutate(MSE = RMSE^2) |>
  select(label, vc, region, predictions, n, pct_fallback, MAE, MSE, RMSE, R2,
         bias, mean_observed, mean_predicted) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

## By type {.tabset}

```{r resid-by-group, results = "asis", fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
walk(unique(vars$group), \(g) {
  cat("\n\n### ", g, "\n\n", sep = "")
  filter(vars, group == g) |>
    pwalk(\(layer, label, is_share, vc, ...) {
      unit <- if (is_share) "% share" else "% cover"
      ylab <- paste0(if (is_share) "Share" else "Cover", " (%)")
      df <- resid_df(layer, vc)
      cat("\n\n", label, ": ", nrow(df), " pixel-years (", vc, ")\n\n",
          sep = "")

      if (layer == "cover_tree" && wall) {
        lim <- max(abs(c(raster_quantile(diff_tree, 0.05),
                         raster_quantile(diff_tree, 0.95))))
        print(plot_map_conus(diff_tree,
                             colorscale = colorscale_diverging(
                               name = "Predicted -\nRAP (% cover)",
                               limits = c(-lim, lim)),
                             title = "Tree cover - predicted minus RAP 2021",
                             inset_hist = TRUE))
      } else {
        print(plot_resid_points(df, label, unit))
      }
      cat("\n\n")
      print(plot_resid_quantiles(df, label, ylab))
      cat("\n\n")
    })
})
```
